title: Match with Multiple Arms
concept: Use the | operator in match arms to handle multiple patterns with the same result.
why: Many values should produce the same outcome. The | operator avoids duplicating code across multiple arms.
tips: `|` in match means 'or' — matches any of the listed patterns
Group related values with `|` instead of writing separate arms
Mix and match: use `|` for scattered values, ranges for contiguous
All arms including combined ones must return the same type
common_mistakes: Writing `or` instead of `|` — use the pipe character
Forgetting that `|` requires the same result expression on the right
Using `|` when a range would be cleaner: `1|2|3|4|5` → `1..6`
